title: BudgetRequestedData
description: data of budget.requested (PRD 9.5). Raised at 80% of the approved budget with the remaining plan and a new estimate (PRD 14.1, FR-MTR-03). remaining_units are the plan units not finished yet, in plan order; estimate is the new estimate of the run's total credits, spent plus the remaining units (added in 1.1.0; rule MT-04 in contracts/metering.rules.md).

remaining_unit.description: A plan unit not finished yet, with its plan title.
